tasks.short: Provide evidence provenance and test requests to laboratory staff

steps.what: Retrieve the evidence item's source and custody records for laboratory information
inputs: verified case and evidence item identifiers
existing evidence source and custody records
outputs: source-linked evidence history and provenance gaps

steps.what: Determine the laboratory tests to request and clarify any provenance gaps
inputs: source-linked evidence history and provenance gaps
case questions and applicable laboratory submission instructions
outputs: confirmed requested tests and permitted provenance facts

steps.what: Prepare laboratory information with the item's source, requested tests and recipient
inputs: confirmed requested tests and permitted provenance facts
source-linked evidence history
existing verified laboratory contact
outputs: complete laboratory information package and destination

steps.what: Check and approve the completed evidence information and exact laboratory recipient
inputs: complete laboratory information package and destination
source-linked evidence history and requested tests
outputs: approved final laboratory package and destination

steps.what: Send the approved evidence information to the specified laboratory personnel
inputs: approved final laboratory package and destination
outputs: delivered laboratory information

steps.what: Discuss laboratory questions about provenance and test purpose
inputs: delivered laboratory information
laboratory personnel's actual questions
outputs: clarified questions and actual laboratory response

steps.what: Record and confirm actual receipt, questions and follow-up actions
inputs: clarified questions and actual laboratory response
outputs: confirmed final laboratory contact note

steps.what: Save the confirmed laboratory contact note in the case system
inputs: confirmed final laboratory contact note
outputs: saved laboratory contact note

tasks.design: Configure native evidence lookup and laboratory submission templates in {OTHER}, the evidence and case-management system. Preserve source references, let the investigator choose tests and approve the final package, and separately transmit it through the existing authorised laboratory channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence identifiers alone cannot establish provenance or select a useful test.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source-linked fields and submission templates can support retrieval and package assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve provenance gaps and explain what a laboratory result must establish.
tasks.human_edge: Understand evidential context and recognise unresolved uncertainty.

ambition.what: Support the existing laboratory handoff without choosing tests automatically.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6; verify evidence access, laboratory channel authority and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: evidence systems can retrieve linked custody records and populate structured laboratory submission fields.

assumptions: OTHER means the evidence/case system, not a general-purpose public model. Boundary is providing information and clarification, not physically collecting or transferring evidence, performing tests or evaluating final laboratory results.

Existing collecting and custody officers produce case/item ID, source location/date, collector, custody events and relevant source reference in their ordinary records. s1 reads these originals; absent or contradictory entries require manual clarification in s2, not invented provenance. s2 selects test codes and purpose; s3 counts entering new request details and verifying contact from the existing laboratory directory.

Native configuration comes first. Central retains 70% of retrieval and 50% of package preparation, plus removes a real separate transmission action; no existing system runtime earns saving. Same-system s8 is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Actual response capture remains fully counted in s7.

s4 follows the finished package and binds content and destination; changes require renewed approval. s7 confirms its completed note before s8. Provisional B=100, R=78, gross=22; incremental focal field/template upkeep=1; net=21. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Native submission coverage and actual source-record gaps.
research_questions: Trace evidence-to-laboratory handoffs, including original-record checks, package corrections and recipient verification.

already_counted.description: Final package and destination review at s4

incremental.description: Inspect submission mappings and laboratory channel exceptions

approvals.approved_version: complete final evidence information, requested tests and laboratory destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when existing evidence templates already cover the work; high allows four extra hours resolving provenance and field exceptions beyond central net 21.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Summon medical help and request statement support

steps.what: Assess the injured individual's immediate need and actual location
inputs: actual injured individual and scene conditions
outputs: observed need, location and immediate hazards

steps.what: Confirm the medical help request, location and emergency contact before calling
inputs: observed need, location and immediate hazards
existing emergency contact procedure
outputs: confirmed medical help request and destination

steps.what: Summon medical help and communicate actual scene details to the responder
inputs: confirmed medical help request and destination
responder's actual questions
outputs: communicated medical request and responder instructions

steps.what: Confirm the exact request for medical personnel to take statements and the appropriate recipient
inputs: actual case need and injured individual's situation
communicated medical request and responder instructions
outputs: confirmed statement-support request and medical recipient

steps.what: Alert the specified medical personnel to the confirmed request to take statements
inputs: confirmed statement-support request and medical recipient
outputs: communicated statement-support request and actual response

steps.what: Record and confirm actual requests, contact times and medical responses
inputs: communicated medical request and responder instructions
communicated statement-support request and actual response
outputs: confirmed final medical-contact note

steps.what: Save the confirmed medical-contact note in the case record
inputs: confirmed final medical-contact note
outputs: saved medical-contact note

tasks.design: Retain live medical requests through {TELEPHONY} and actual-contact notes in {OTHER}, the case system. Existing emergency contacts and record fields support the investigator; no automated emergency or statement request is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: An urgent medical request depends on actual scene conditions and responder questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing contacts and structured notes support communication but establish no extra saving.
tasks.still_hard: Convey changing needs accurately and coordinate with medical personnel.
tasks.human_edge: Observe urgency and respond to live questions.

ambition.what: Retain immediate human communication and medical authority.

build_days.testing_rollout: 0-1; inspect current contact and note controls

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: medical assistance requests involve live communication of actual scene details and responder clarification.

assumptions: OTHER in s1 is the physical scene; OTHER in record steps is the case-management system. The investigator's request work is counted; medical treatment, taking a statement and responder travel are outside focal labour and unchanged.

The investigator supplies actual location, observed need and hazards, confirms each intended request and recipient before its separate call, and captures actual contact time, response and instructions in s6. Request confirmation represents immediate human judgement, not a delayed approval workflow; no tool requires waiting before summoning help.

Native contact access and note templates are considered. No separate repeated search, transcription or re-keying baseline is established; s6 already records actual information in the native form. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving.

Each confirmation binds the intended call and recipient; changed requests require immediate renewed confirmation. Medical personnel retain decisions about clinical care and whether/when statement support is feasible. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual emergency contact and note practice.
research_questions: Review representative contact records without delaying live response and identify any separately evidenced administrative repetition.

approvals.approved_version: confirmed medical help request, actual location and destination
confirmed statement-support request and medical recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No established reduction after splitting each call, actual contact-note capture and same-system save.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Notify medical examiner or prosecutor representative

steps.what: Read actual case facts and the applicable examiner or prosecutor notification procedure
inputs: existing actual case records
current authorised notification procedure
outputs: relevant case facts and notification requirements

steps.what: Find the current medical examiner or prosecutor representative contact for the case
inputs: relevant case facts and notification requirements
existing authorised contact directory
outputs: applicable verified notification contact

steps.what: Decide notification urgency, permitted content and whether to notify directly or request notification
inputs: relevant case facts and notification requirements
applicable verified notification contact
outputs: confirmed notification route, content decisions and urgency

steps.what: Prepare the notification or notification request with final case facts and recipient
inputs: confirmed notification route, content decisions and urgency
relevant case facts
applicable verified notification contact
outputs: complete final notification payload and destination

steps.what: Review and approve the final notification content, route and recipient
inputs: complete final notification payload and destination
outputs: approved final notification payload and destination

steps.what: Send the approved notification to the selected representative or authorised notifying colleague
inputs: approved final notification payload and destination
outputs: sent notification or routed notification request

steps.what: Record and confirm actual notification acknowledgement or unresolved delivery status
inputs: sent notification or routed notification request
recipient's actual acknowledgement or observed lack of delivery
outputs: confirmed final notification-status note

steps.what: Save the confirmed notification-status note in the same case system
inputs: confirmed final notification-status note
outputs: saved notification-status record

tasks.design: Configure contact lookup and a structured notification template in {OTHER}, the authorised case and notification system. The investigator decides route and urgency, approves the completed notification and separately releases it; actual acknowledgement remains explicit.
tasks.previous_blocker: A case record does not itself determine whether, whom or how urgently to notify.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contact filters and payload templates can support the administrative part.
tasks.still_hard: Choose the correct notification under actual case conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge urgency and the meaning of incomplete facts.

ambition.what: Improve the current notification handoff without automating case judgement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify case access, notification authority and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: authorised case systems can filter maintained contacts and assemble structured notification fields.

assumptions: Central scenario is direct notification to an external examiner or prosecutor representative; the authority of s6 is act_external for that route. If requesting an internal colleague to notify instead, use write_internal for the routed request and count the colleague's actual unchanged notification separately outside focal labour; do not add that branch's effort to this direct-route denominator.

Existing case owners supply actual case ID, event facts, location and source timestamps; directory owner supplies recipient role, coverage, current contact and authorised channel. s1 verifies source facts, s3 decides permitted content/urgency, and s4 counts entry of any new decisions. Missing facts or contact coverage require manual resolution, not guessed fields.

Native lookup/templates come first. Central retains 70% of contact lookup and 50% of notification preparation and removes a real transmission action. Urgent live phone notification remains manual and is a zero-saving alternative. s7 captures actual acknowledgement; a sent flag is not receipt.

Final payload exists before s5 approval; changes void it. Same-system s8 save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=80.5, gross=19.5; incremental focal contact/template upkeep=1; net=18.5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Direct versus delegated and electronic versus live-call notification mix.
research_questions: Trace notification cases, checking actual recipient lookup, approval, delivery and acknowledgement effort.

already_counted.description: Final notification review retained in s5

incremental.description: Review contact coverage and notification-template exceptions

approvals.approved_version: complete final notification payload, route and destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero for native-covered or live-call notifications; high allows four extra hours resolving recipient or payload exceptions beyond central net 18.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain establishment surveillance and record identifying observations

steps.what: Read the authorised establishment surveillance brief and known identifying information
inputs: existing authorised surveillance brief
existing case identifiers
outputs: understood observation scope and reference identifiers

steps.what: Maintain surveillance of the establishment and observe actual suspect identifying details
inputs: understood observation scope and reference identifiers
actual establishment activity
outputs: actual observed identifying details and uncertainty

steps.what: Record actual identifying observations with times, sources and uncertainty
inputs: actual observed identifying details and uncertainty
outputs: actual source-linked surveillance notes

steps.what: Check observed identifiers against authorised case references without treating resemblance as identity
inputs: actual source-linked surveillance notes
existing authorised case identifiers
outputs: checked observations and unresolved identification questions

steps.what: Prepare the surveillance observation report and specified case-team recipient
inputs: checked observations and unresolved identification questions
actual source-linked surveillance notes
outputs: complete final observation report and internal destination

steps.what: Review and approve the finished report, uncertainty wording and internal destination
inputs: complete final observation report and internal destination
actual source-linked surveillance notes
outputs: approved final observation report and destination

steps.what: Release the approved report to the authorised case team in the same case system
inputs: approved final observation report and destination
outputs: released internal surveillance report

tasks.design: Retain investigator observation and source-based checks at {OTHER}, the physical observation location and authorised case system. Use the existing observation form and report controls; no automatic suspect identification or faster surveillance period is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Identifying observations depend on visibility, continuity and uncertainty at the scene.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case forms support notes and reports but do not establish an additional time reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Separate a reliable identifying observation from resemblance or inference.
tasks.human_edge: Notice context and preserve uncertainty in the record.

ambition.what: Preserve observation quality without expanding surveillance capability.

build_days.testing_rollout: 0-1; inspect native form and release controls

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: investigators distinguish actual observations from inferred identity and preserve source references in case records.

assumptions: Boundary includes brief/reference access, observation, actual note capture, identifier checking, report preparation and internal release. Surveillance authorisation exists before the task; no new surveillance method or biometric matching is introduced.

Investigator supplies actual time, location, observed identifier, observation source and uncertainty in s3. Existing case owner supplies authorised reference identifiers. Missing or ambiguous details stay unresolved rather than being inferred. Notes and report work are separate from physical observation.

Native forms and report templates are considered; their existing assembly is already available, so no repeated copying baseline is invented. Drafting assistance is also considered but no faster report preparation is established once source/meaning checks are included. Therefore s3 and s5 retain full time rather than assuming a report saving.

s6 follows the complete report and approves exact destination; edits void approval. Same-system s7 release is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual source-note and report preparation burden under current native tools.
research_questions: Observe the record workflow separately from surveillance and measure all source and meaning checks before changing report preparation.

incremental.description: No new workflow or upkeep introduced

approvals.approved_version: final surveillance report, uncertainty wording and authorised internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction after separately examining lookup, actual notes, report drafting, review and internal release.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Investigators retain live response, surveillance and evidential judgement; native tools can support bounded information handoffs.
reach: Laboratory liaison: learn accepted submission fields and provenance-gap handling
skills_to_grow: Record actual acknowledgement rather than assuming receipt
role.ambitious_version: An investigator makes clear, source-grounded handoffs while keeping case judgement and urgent communication human.
